title: Land stranded mergefinish and PE-repro work: pinned merge finish in local-workflow and content-derived MSVC links
goal: Port 1e6631fe0 and 231f171f5 onto current main. The OS-UCRT boundary requests /Brepro so independent MSVC links of Susi and its native helpers are content-derived, with a Windows fixture that retains two-root raw PE evidence. cargo local-workflow finish-merge publishes only a resolved, fully staged, in-scope merge whose incoming parent is pinned by full object ID, preserving both parents and the staged tree; wrong parents, dirty state, sequencers and signing leave refs untouched, and a retry cleans up an already-published merge.
